title: Contains Duplicate
description: Given an integer array `nums`, return `true` if any value appears at least twice in the array, and return `false` if every element is distinct.
input_format: First line contains integer `n`, followed by `n` integers.
output_format: true if duplicates exist, false otherwise.
hints: Use a hash set to track elements as you iterate.
If an element is already in the set, a duplicate is found.
Comparing `len(set(nums))` to `len(nums)` solves this in O(n).

starter_code.python:
# Contains Duplicate
import sys

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data: return
    # Write your solution here
    pass

if __name__ == '__main__':
    solve()

reference_solution:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    n = int(data[0])
    nums = [int(x) for x in data[1:1+n]]
    print('true' if len(set(nums)) < len(nums) else 'false')
